name: Ajwa Projects
summary: Ajwa Projects, a Surat-based company incorporated in 2011, provides fabrication, erection, piping, pressure equipment, civil construction and maintenance services to oil and gas, power, steel and cement clients, with over 93% of FY26 revenue coming from Gujarat. Revenue from operations grew from ₹34.3 cr in FY24 to ₹48.4 cr in FY26, and profit rose 65% in FY26 to ₹5.4 cr, an 11.2% net margin with RoNW of 36%. The ₹38 cr issue is ₹30.45 cr fresh and ₹7.6 cr offer for sale by two promoters whose average cost is ₹3.40–₹4.10 a share; the top 10 customers made up about 87% of FY26 revenue. On full-year FY26 profit the post-issue P/E is about 20.6x, well above the two listed peers named in the prospectus (9.5x and 16.0x).

checks.name: Revenue growth
checks.finding: Revenue from operations rose from ₹34.27 cr (FY24) to ₹48.42 cr (FY26), a CAGR of about 18.9%.

checks.name: Revenue rose every year
checks.finding: Revenue grew every year: ₹34.27 cr, ₹36.73 cr, ₹48.42 cr (FY24–FY26).

checks.name: Debt to equity
checks.finding: Debt to equity was 0.71 in FY26 (borrowings ₹12.52 cr vs net worth ₹17.71 cr) and 0.72 at June 2026.

checks.name: Debt growing slower than revenue
checks.finding: Borrowings rose about 15% (₹10.85 cr to ₹12.52 cr) while total income rose about 41% over FY24–FY26.

checks.name: Net worth rising
checks.finding: Net worth rose every year: ₹8.90 cr, ₹12.29 cr, ₹17.71 cr (FY24–FY26).

checks.name: Positive operating cash flow
checks.finding: Operating cash flow figures were not found in public sources.

checks.name: Profit growth
checks.finding: Profit after tax grew about 65% in FY26, to ₹5.42 cr from ₹3.28 cr.

checks.name: Profit margin trend
checks.finding: Net margin improved from about 8.6% (FY24) to 8.9% (FY25) and 11.2% (FY26).

checks.name: Return on equity
